title: Product Manager - Seller Tools
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user-centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions. You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end-users, and engineering — shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you\'ll do:

  • Own some of the Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short-term feature delivery with long-term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator-friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI-driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you\'ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data-centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud-based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade-offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business-focused.

More about you:

  • You’re equally comfortable discussing a product roadmap with business stakeholders and reviewing API contracts or data models with engineers;
  • You’re passionate about building products that simplify complex workflows and drive measurable impact;
  • You see product management as a craft — combining user empathy, business acumen, technical fluency, and data-driven decision-making;
  • You thrive in cross-functional environments and can navigate ambiguity with clarity;
  • You balance visionary thinking with practical execution, knowing when to go deep technically and when to focus on user outcomes.

What We Offer:

Nossos Student Marketeers fazem parte do programa de embaixadores de marca mais dinâmico e capacitado do mundo. Isso inclui o contato direto com consumidores e clientes, convidando a experimentação de produtos, além de trabalhar em eventos da Red Bull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores. Trabalhe em eventos da Red Bull e eventos apoiados, para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores.

Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolver, planejar e acompanhar as atividades de vendas em clientes de alta gastronomia e de valor agregado, identificando oportunidades para nossas linhas premium e terceiros importados. Visando atingir as metas propostas pela empresa.
  • Acompanhar estoques, utilizando-se de planilhas e sistema próprio, considerando a programação de vendas e produção, analisando demanda versus oferta, visando assim, atender a todos os clientes.
  • Desenvolver e organizar a execução dos planos e programas de vendas, seguindo o orçado versus o realizado, visando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Visitar clientes classificados como Premium (alta gastronomia), visando realizar “vendas” e identificando as oportunidades e, nossas linhas premium.
  • Estabelecer o “mix” de produtos (premium e terceiros importados) a ser trabalhado, com base na demanda de mercado, visando otimizar a capacidade de produção da fábrica e atender a necessidades do mercado.
  • Desenvolver/organizar e acompanhar a execução dos planos e programas de vendas elaborados, visando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela organização.
  • Responsável por incluir em sistema os lançamentos de pedidos de compra dos clientes, acompanhar faturamento, programação logística, embarque e entrega ao cliente.
  • Trabalhar a visibilidade das marcas premium e terceiros importados nos clientes de alta gastronomia agregando valor a marca.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior completo em Comércio Exterior, Administração e afins.
  • Vivencia em Vendas, Trading, Adm. Vendas ou Inteligência Comercial/ Negócios;

  • CNH B válida.

description:
Overview

Especialista de Gestão da Qualidade - MDSAP. Join to apply for the role at Bureau Veritas North America. Buscamos profissionais engajados e alinhados aos nossos valores, para atuar como Especialista em Gestão da Qualidade para MDSAP.

A NCC Group é um organismo de certificação e laboratório de testes, parte do grupo Bureau Veritas. Acreditado pela Cgcre como Organismo de Certificação de Produto (OCP), Organismo de Certificação de Sistema (OCS) e Organismo de Certificação de Sistemas de Gestão de Produtos para Saúde (OMD) e como Organismo de Certificação Designado pela Anatel para certificação de produtos para telecomunicações de forma imparcial e objetiva. O Bureau Veritas foi fundado em 1828, líder mundial em Testes, Inspeção e Certificação (TIC), oferecendo serviços de certificação e auditoria nas áreas de Qualidade, Saúde e Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social, entre outros.

Responsibilities

  • Garantia de qualidade: Implementar e manter o sistema de gestão da qualidade direcionado para o MDSAP, garantindo conformidade com os padrões do programa.
  • Monitoramento e auditoria: Programar e realizar auditorias internas para avaliar a conformidade dos processos e procedimentos, identificando não-conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Análise de dados: Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados para identificar tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria na qualidade dos serviços.
  • Gerenciamento de riscos: Implementar estratégias para identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos relacionados à qualidade dos serviços prestados dentro do programa MDSAP.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento: Capacitar a equipe sobre práticas de qualidade, segurança e conformidade, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua.
  • Gestão de processos: Mapear, otimizar e padronizar processos para garantir eficiência, segurança e conformidade.
  • Gestão de documentos: Desenvolver, revisar e manter a documentação relacionada à qualidade, incluindo procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e registros.
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores: Monitorar e analisar indicadores de qualidade para avaliar o desempenho e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Gestão de não conformidades: Investigar e gerenciar não conformidades, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas para evitar recorrências.
  • Gestão de mudanças: Liderar e implementar mudanças relacionadas à qualidade, segurança e conformidade, garantindo adesão da equipe.

Requisitos

  • Graduação na área de gestão da qualidade ou áreas afins (administração, engenharia biomédica) com especialização em gestão da qualidade.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão da qualidade, ferramentas de análise de dados, gerenciamento de riscos, auditoria e normas regulatórias.
  • Conhecimento e experiência nos requisitos da ISO 13485 e ISO 17021-1.
  • Diferencial: experiência em IMDRF e MDR (marcação CE).
  • Diferencial: Inglês Avançado.
  • Desejável: Curso de Auditor Líder em ISO 13485 ou ISO 9001 com curso complementar de ISO 13485.

Experiência

Ter atuado na área de gestão da qualidade do setor médico (ex.: certificadoras da área médica, empresas do setor médico regulado) com foco na organização de procedimentos e gestão de auditorias com foco específico em MDSAP.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Na área de física de aceleradores e radiações, as atividades estão relacionadas a estudos analíticos, simulações matemáticas/numéricas, discussão de algoritmos, implementação de scripts de controle, concepção e acompanhamento de testes, experimentos com o feixe (de elétrons, prótons ou fótons) em aceleradores, análises de interação da radiação com a matéria, pesquisa avançada e design em aceleradores, radiações e suas aplicações, análise de dados e métodos de diagnóstico para aprimoramento dos experimentos nos aceleradores.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

Como Gerente de Turno, você será responsável por liderar a operação noturna de uma Estação de Entrega. Seu papel envolverá fornecer suporte e liderança para Líderes de Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores de Serviços de Entrega, além de gerenciar relacionamentos e o desempenho de agências externas. Você fará parte de um ambiente altamente colaborativo, dinâmico e inovador, onde ideias são valorizadas e experimentação é incentivada. Nosso objetivo é encontrar soluções criativas e práticas para entregar os melhores resultados aos nossos clientes. Buscamos profissionais com um histórico de excelência em qualidade e foco no cliente, que prosperem em cenários rápidos e desafiadores, e que estejam prontos para atuar em contextos de alta ambiguidade e constantes mudanças. Se você gosta de desafios e está preparado para liderar e entregar resultados em um ambiente que combina o dinamismo de uma start-up com a estrutura de uma grande empresa, queremos conhecer você!

Key job responsibilities

  • Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega, no turno da noite. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes;
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos;
  • Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente;
  • Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais;
  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico;
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback;
  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções;
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário;
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em Operações de segmentos como Logística, Manufatura, Indústria geral e áreas afins;
  • Experiencia com gestão de pessoas;
  • MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no período da noite (23h as 10h) e em turnos flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana e feriados;
  • Inglês intermediário e Português fluente;
  • Experiencia em E-commerce;
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de projetos ou de processos;
  • Inglês Avançado;

title: DSP Bioprocess Laboratory Scientist or Engineer
description:
Overview


Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.


Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an experienced downstream bioprocess scientist to conduct hands-on experiments in separation processes relevant in fermentation DSP. The candidate will generate process development data around broth clarification and product purification for new fermentation systems. The ideal candidate will be familiar with centrifugation, various filtration steps, ion exchange, crystallization, precipitation, distillation, and others. The DSP Laboratory Scientist will work closely with the DSP bioprocess engineer (who is responsible for designing the process) and will be the hands-on lead to ensure proper data is generated for successful scale-up of novel bioprocesses.


Responsibilities



  • Perform routine and complex laboratory tests following existing protocols and following all safety practices.

  • Develop new experimental setups and document operating procedures for these new capabilities.

  • Work closely with support functions in the facility to prepare the site, procure, and install new laboratory equipment

  • Conduct pre-startup safety review on all new capabilities installed in laboratory.

  • Develop experimental plans in collaboration with the DSP bioprocess engineer, and conduct all experiments necessary to generate process development data.

  • Write reports and develop presentations to communicate key results and conclusions from lab experiments.

  • Work closely with senior engineers to write and develop tech transfer documentation for pilot and demo scales

  • Work closely with engineers at the pilot and/or demo plants to troubleshoot operational issues and find creative ways to continuously improve the process

  • Maintain a clean and operational DSP bioprocess laboratory


Additional Responsibilities and Activities



  • Stay updated on new laboratory equipment and techniques that may be useful for DSP in bioprocesses.

  • Work with different teams within Braskem (e.g., process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.


Qualifications



  • B.S. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or other relevant field

  • 5+ years experience in bioprocess laboratory

  • Demonstrated experience in process development for fermentation product purification

  • Experience with centrifugation, filtration (ultra, micro, nano), ion exchange, crystallization, distillation and other relevant separation techniques in purification of fermentation products

  • Strong technical discipline to develop, conduct, and present the results of an experimental plan

  • Ability to ensure good interpersonal relationships to work on projects with internal and external interfaces

  • English and Portuguese fluency is required

  • Candidate will work onsite at Braskem’s laboratory in Campinas, Brazil.


Seniority level



  • Mid-Senior level


Employment type



  • Full-time


Job function



  • Research, Analyst, and Information Technology


Industries



  • Plastics Manufacturing

description:
Descrição da vaga

We are looking for a highly motivated Product Engineer to lead the integration of transmission systems for hybrid and internal combustion vehicle platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of embedded control systems, diagnostics, and cross - functional collaboration in a global environment.

The selected candidate will interface with systems and calibration engineers to align on functional requirements, assess impacts on regulatory and safety standards, and lead the implementation of software and diagnostic strategies. You will be responsible for ensuring software quality, calibration traceability, and validation of system performance throughout the product lifecycle.

Responsabilidades

  • Interface with systems and calibration teams to interpret and refine control requirements.
  • Lead assessments and documentation related to regulatory compliance and functional safety.
  • Develop diagnostic strategies and clearly communicate with global stakeholders via reports and presentations.
  • Review and mark up control models to meet diagnostic and systems design criteria.
  • Manage software and calibration integration for automatic transmissions.
  • Track and document software versions, issues, and change requests.
  • Perform fault analysis, data acquisition, and control system validation (PID, cruise, performance).
  • Support software releases, troubleshooting, and vehicle-level testing during development and production phases.

Qualificações

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal).
  • Experience with automotive ECUs, control systems, hydraulic/electrical subsystems, and combustion physics.
  • Solid knowledge of internal combustion engines and hybrid powertrain systems.
  • Familiarity with propulsion components (engine, driveline, electric/hydraulic subsystems).
  • Resumes in English.

Technical Skills:

  • V-cycle software development process understanding.
  • Experience with problem-solving techniques (DFMEA, DFSS, DVPR).
  • Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Knowledge of tools for project tracking and development workflows.
  • Understanding of development architectures such as aSPICE, PLE, AUTOSAR, and ISO 26262.
  • Advanced proficiency with MATLAB/Simulink and control model development.
  • Experience with ETAS INCA, CANalyzer, and Candela (Vector tools).
  • Programming skills in C or C++; Python is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CAN protocol (SAE J1939).
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and diagnostic skills.

  • Clear and confident communicator across technical and non-technical teams.

title: DSP Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional downstream bioprocess engineer for conceptual process design and scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will have primary responsibility for downstream commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioprocess scale-up with experience in industrial implementation of new technology, technological knowledge of purification techniques for bio-processes, and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the conceptual process from broth clarification through product purification for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab.
  • Work closely with the research team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide in planning for the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigated as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation and downstream units.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Generate the technology transfer package for the DSP section of the bioprocess. Serve as the DSP process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended periods.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package (PDP) that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.
  • Carry out techno-economic assessments, actively participating in the preparation and/or technical review of mass and energy balances, PFD's, Capex and Opex estimates, among others.
  • Work with different teams within Braskem (e.g., process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.
  • Collaborate with universities, start-ups and technology hubs seeking new technologies that may be of interest to Braskem.

Requirements

  • B.S. in Chemical Engineering or relevant field (Ph.D. is a plus) with a strong background in new technology development
  • 10+ years (including graduate research) experience in bioprocess engineering
  • Demonstrated experience in process development for fermentation product purification and implementation of new bioprocess technology at industrial scale.
  • Demonstrated expertise using process simulation software (SuperPro and/or Aspen Plus and Aspen Economic Analyzer)
  • Experience in pilot plant and/or demo plant operation
  • Experience with both solvent-based and aqueous-based recovery processes is a plus
  • Strong technical judgement to assess project decisions and timetables
  • Ability and seniority to ensure good interpersonal relationships and people management, to work on projects with internal and external interfaces
  • Have a working knowledge of intellectual property.
  • English and Portuguese fluency is required
  • Candidate will work in a hybrid mode with a home site of Campinas, Brazil to ensure a close working relationship with research teams at the Braskem Tech Centers.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Engineering and Information Technology

Industries

  • Plastics Manufacturing

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning process of data centers, ensuring that all electrical systems are installed, tested, and operational according to project specifications and standards.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • Implementar e sustentar lógicas de bloqueio/desbloqueio, reprocessos, exceções de cobrança e reconciliação de dados.
  • Construir APIs e fluxos assíncronos (mensageria) com foco em alta disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas.
  • Monitorar saúde das aplicações (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e atuar em incidentes de produção.
  • Trabalhar próximo(a) a áreas de Produto, Arquitetura, Dados, SRE e Negócios para traduzir regras financeiras complexas em software confiável.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de padrões técnicos e melhoria contínua do ecossistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sênior em backend com Java ou Kotlin (aceitamos forte base em outra stack + disposição para migrar).
  • Vivência com microsserviços e APIs REST em produção.
  • Uso de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ ou equivalente) para fluxos assíncronos.
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server etc.), incluindo modelagem e tuning.
  • Experiência em integrações financeiras (ex: CNAB, APIs bancárias, cobrança/consignado, boletos ou arrecadação).
  • Testes automatizados (unitários + integração) e uso de CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes Linux/containers (Docker, Kubernetes ou similar).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com processos de consignado ou arrecadação multibanco.
  • Manipulação de grandes volumes de transações e controles de idempotência.
  • Padrões de resiliência: retry, backoff, circuit breaker, dead-letter, compensações.
  • Observabilidade avançada (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic, Splunk).
  • Experiência em sistemas regulados (bancário, pagamentos, fintechs).
  • Exposição a data lakes / pipelines de conciliação / batch crítico.
  • Conhecimento de segurança aplicada a integrações financeiras (certificados, mTLS, segregação de credenciais, auditoria).

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Senior Software Engineer (Women Applicants Only)
description:
About QuintoAndar
QuintoAndar was born to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors for technology to be part of living. And, through it, we simplify and reduce the bureaucracy of the experience of those looking for a new home. Thus, we became the most valuable proptech in Latin America, leading the real estate market in around six countries and more than 75 cities around the globe.

The first steps in the international market have been taken since we acquired Grupo Navent, which is ranked number 1 in Mexico (Inmuebles24), Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) and Ecuador (Plusvalia) - among others. And most recently, we launched Benvi, our international brand in Mexico, which comes with our residential rental product and service.

We offer an end-to-end ecosystem to make life easier for those looking to rent or buy a home, sell a property and unlock a transaction. Think of zero paper or bureaucracy: everything happens on a single platform, with transparency and speed alongside incredible human support.

We are currently valued at over $5.1 billion (August 2021) and continue to grow 4x year over year, breaking records.

To make all this happen, we have more than 4,000 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and best design practices to ensure a seamless experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with smart financial products. Here you will work with the best professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration and high performance.

To learn more about our history, visit .

About Grupo QuintoAndar:

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diverse portfolio of brands and solutions that cover all stages of the journey of living. We develop technologies and innovations that transform and leverage the whole living experience.

About working at QuintoAndar:

  • Possibility of learning;
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools in the market;
  • Work in an informal environment with a horizontal structure;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo and Campinas or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.

Language

This job description is written in English because for that position you will need it for communications with coworkers and suppliers who are from worldwide, for tools and internal materials as well. // A descrição desta vaga está escrita em Inglês porque para esta posição é necessário para a comunicação com colegas e fornecedores, que são de diferentes países, além do uso de ferramentas e materiais internos.

Stages of the Selection Process

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

  • Application
  • Tech Screening
  • Technicals Interviews with Engineering Team
  • Phone interview with Recruiters
  • Offer

About the Area:

These are the Senior Software Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Develop independent (micro-)services that address specific solutions;
  • Responsible for the entire lifecycle of their code;
  • Contribute not only with your immediate team’s challenges but with the whole procut team team - by sharing inputs/code/etc;
  • Improve the development experience at QuintoAndar by enhancing development tools, test coverage, and/or code structure;
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions of software design. Building and helping to create documentations;
  • Create scalable, maintainable and user driven solutions. We use several different technologies: from Java over SQL databases, to Polymer over MongoDB. We also have micro-services written in Java, Python, Node or Clojure, gorgeous PWA experiences in React, complex data flows in Datomic . You don't need to know all these upfront, but we will give you space to learn and improve;
  • Help organize software architecture to harmonically orchestrate our services architecture.

Seniority Level:

We want to have as many talented people as possible in our team. So, although this position is described as “Senior Software Engineer”, you can apply even if you don’t consider yourself as a senior professional yet. It’s important to us to create a qualified talent poll and we will definitely reach out to you if we think you can add to our teams, no matter what seniority level you are today.

What we are looking for:

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language and relational databases;
  • Experience using RESTful APIs;
  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through high-quality data-driven and structured software, valuing work-life balance;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and knowledge in English - we usually use English to write our code, documentation, tools, reference materials and eventually talk to partners and co-workers from other countries;
  • Excellent english skills (verbal and written) is mandatory.

You'll stand out if you:

  • Know computer theory, including optimization of algorithms and distributed systems;
  • Already developed scalable client-server mobile applications;
  • Have experience with cloud service platforms and its services (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc);
  • Understand how modern CD/CI works;
  • Have some knowledge on containers and container-orchestration (eg. Kubernetes);
  • Know how to test and tune scalability;
  • Understand the work is never done; we are always taking care and evolving our services.

Important:

  • Our selection process starts with the application! If you are truly interested in joining our team, make sure to put in extra effort at this stage. We review all candidates individually and provide feedback even to those who do not proceed in the process;
  • All communication is done via email, so be attentive to our messages and whitelist the @quintoandar.com.br domain to prevent our emails from going to spam.

  • Health plan;

  • Life insurance;
  • Daycare subsidy;
  • Subsidy to sports practicing (Gympass).
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave;
  • Reserved room for breast-feeding*;
  • Discount on our parking lot;*
  • Educational discounts;
  • Free transfer from Vila Madalena and Fradique Coutinho stations to the office*;
  • Free bike rack in our parking lot.*

Diversity & Inclusion at QuintoAndar

At QuintoAndar, we believe diversity of perspectives and experiences guarantee a differentiated work environment, based on respect and valuing differences. title: Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657
description:
Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657

Join to apply for the Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657 role at AgileEngine.

Overview

As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.

What you will do

  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement: Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures; Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility; Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments; Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation: Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations; Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings; Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.

About QuintoAndar
QuintoAndar was born to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors for technology to be part of living. And, through it, we simplify and reduce the bureaucracy of the experience of those looking for a new home. Thus, we became the most valuable proptech in Latin America, leading the real estate market in around six countries and more than 75 cities around the globe.

The first steps in the international market have been taken since we acquired Grupo Navent, which is ranked number 1 in Mexico (Inmuebles24), Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) and Ecuador (Plusvalia) - among others. And most recently, we launched Benvi, our international brand in Mexico, which comes with our residential rental product and service.

We offer an end-to-end ecosystem to make life easier for those looking to rent or buy a home, sell a property and unlock a transaction. Think of zero paper or bureaucracy: everything happens on a single platform, with transparency and speed alongside incredible human support.

We are currently valued at over $5.1 billion (August 2021) and continue to grow 4x year over year, breaking records.

To make all this happen, we have more than 4,000 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and best design practices to ensure a seamless experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with smart financial products. Here you will work with the best professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration and high performance.

To learn more about our history, visit .

About Grupo QuintoAndar:

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diverse portfolio of brands and solutions that cover all stages of the journey of living. We develop technologies and innovations that transform and leverage the whole living experience.

About working at QuintoAndar:

  • Possibility of learning;
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools in the market;
  • Work in an informal environment with a horizontal structure;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo and Campinas or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.

Language

This job description is written in English because for that position you will need it for communications with coworkers and suppliers who are from worldwide, for tools and internal materials as well. // A descrição desta vaga está escrita em Inglês porque para esta posição é necessário para a comunicação com colegas e fornecedores, que são de diferentes países, além do uso de ferramentas e materiais internos.

Stages of the Selection Process

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

  • Application
  • Phone interview with Recruiters
  • Tech Screening
  • Technicals Interviews with Engineering Team
  • Offer

About the Area:

These are the Senior Software Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Develop independent (micro-)services that address specific solutions;
  • Responsible for the entire lifecycle of their code;
  • Contribute not only with your immediate team’s challenges but with the whole procut team team - by sharing inputs/code/etc;
  • Improve the development experience at QuintoAndar by enhancing development tools, test coverage, and/or code structure;
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions of software design. Building and helping to create documentations;
  • Create scalable, maintainable and user driven solutions. We use several different technologies: from Java over SQL databases, to Polymer over MongoDB. We also have micro-services written in Java, Python, Node or Clojure, gorgeous PWA experiences in React, complex data flows in Datomic . You don't need to know all these upfront, but we will give you space to learn and improve;
  • Help organize software architecture to harmonically orchestrate our services architecture.

Seniority Level:

We want to have as many talented people as possible in our team. So, although this position is described as “Senior Software Engineer”, you can apply even if you don’t consider yourself as a senior professional yet. It’s important to us to create a qualified talent poll and we will definitely reach out to you if we think you can add to our teams, no matter what seniority level you are today.

What we are looking for:

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language and relational databases;
  • Experience using RESTful APIs;
  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through high-quality data-driven and structured software, valuing work-life balance;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and knowledge in English - we usually use English to write our code, documentation, tools, reference materials and eventually talk to partners and co-workers from other countries;

You'll stand out if you:

Important:

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Overview


Join to apply for the Principal Product Manager role at AB InBev .


AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.


About AB InBev Growth Group


Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world


.In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.


We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.


About the Role


We’re seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Principal Product Manager to shape the future of our sales systems and tools. In this highly autonomous, individual contributor role, you’ll lead initiatives that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of our frontline sales teams including field, administrative, and tele-sales functions.


You’ll take a step back to uncover foundational opportunities that drive long-term impact across the business. Your work will help unify sales workflows, elevate user experience, and influence how we scale and support sales organizations.


What You’ll Do



  • Develop deep expertise in how frontline sales teams operate by identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs through research and partnership.

  • Create and champion a strategic product vision that aligns user workflows, business goals, and emerging trends in sales operations.

  • Define mid- to long-term initiatives that improve productivity, scalability, and system usability.

  • Collaborate with partners in product, engineering, design, data, and sales operations to frame high-impact problems and explore solutions. Connect business strategy, user needs, and technical capabilities to influence product direction and priorities.

  • Advocate for changes across process, technology, and organizational practices that deliver meaningful impact.

  • Clearly articulate trade-offs and opportunities to senior stakeholders and help guide resource allocation across teams.


What We’re Looking For



  • Proven success leading strategic product initiatives in complex environments, ideally at the principal level or equivalent.

  • Ability to think holistically and long-term, with a focus on solving systemic issues over incremental improvements.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful insights, and use metrics to drive strategic decision.

  • Experience working in or closely with field sales, tele-sales, or sales operations organizations

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong product intuition, user empathy, and a systems-thinking mindset.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and thriving in a role with high autonomy and broad scope


Preferred Qualifications



  • Background in B2B sales systems, CRM platforms, or internal tools supporting sales teams.

  • Experience leading discovery and research in enterprise or cross-functional environments

  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, with the ability to collaborate closely with designers to deliver intuitive and effective sales tools.

  • Ability to evaluate technical solutions in collaboration with engineering teams and make informed decisions that balance user needs, scalability, and complexity.

  • Advanced degree in business, operations, or a related field is a plus—especially if it supports strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and organizational change. Equivalent experience is equally valued.


More about you



  • You´re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.

  • You´re motivated by building world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world.

  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;

  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;

  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;

  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.


What We Offer

  • Discounts on Ambev products*

  • School materials assurance

title: Auxiliar de qualidade - SAC
description:
Resumo

O Auxiliar de Controle de Qualidade é responsável por garantir que os serviços prestados pela empresa atendam aos padrões de excelência estabelecidos, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e aprimorando o desempenho dos colaboradores. Através de análises criteriosas, esse profissional identifica áreas de melhoria e auxilia no aperfeiçoamento contínuo dos processos de atendimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar ligações para os clientes que foram atendidos e geraram Ordens de Serviço (OS), buscando obter feedback sobre a experiência do cliente e verificar se suas necessidades foram plenamente atendidas.
  • Monitorar e acompanhar clientes que tiveram ocorrências recorrentes, identificando possíveis problemas sistêmicos ou de atendimento e buscando soluções eficazes para evitar reincidências.
  • Analisar casos críticos de clientes insatisfeitos e situações de cancelamento de contratos, investigando os motivos e propondo medidas corretivas para evitar futuros problemas.
  • Identificar e pontuar os erros cometidos por colaboradores em atendimentos, seguindo critérios pré-definidos de avaliação, para possibilitar a melhoria do desempenho individual e coletivo.
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos de atendimento e na comunicação entre a empresa e os clientes, com o objetivo de elevar a qualidade do serviço prestado e garantir a satisfação do público atendido.
  • Registrar os resultados das avaliações e análises em relatórios detalhados, compartilhando as informações com a equipe de atendimento e a gestão, a fim de promover ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões com a equipe de atendimento, fornecendo feedback construtivo para o aprimoramento das habilidades e competências dos colaboradores.
  • Participar de reuniões de calibração com os gestores para garantir a uniformidade e consistência nas avaliações dos atendimentos.
  • Reconhecer e compartilhar as melhores práticas de atendimento e solução de problemas, a fim de disseminar conhecimento e incentivar a adoção de comportamentos eficientes.
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria da qualidade e atendimento ao cliente, colaborando com ideias e implementando soluções para otimização dos processos.

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) located in Brazil, you will play a critical role in supporting 4flow’s North America sales and marketing teams. Your role is to identify and engage potential customers in the US and Canada, generating high-quality leads and setting up meetings for our senior sales team, including Directors and VPs. You will collaborate closely with our global marketing team, US-based Account Executives, and Sales Managers to ensure a seamless lead handoff and help drive the expansion of 4flow’s consulting, supply chain software, and managed transportation solutions across North America.

What Your New Challenge Will Look Like

  • Prospect and qualify potential customers in the US and North American market using platforms like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and tools such as Outreach, Reev, Meetime, Snov.io, HubSpot, and Salesforce HVS.

  • Schedule qualified meetings for 4flow Directors and VPs—this is your primary KPI.
  • Conduct account-based research to support targeted campaigns, understand company priorities, and map key stakeholders across supply chain, logistics, and IT functions.
  • Collaborate with marketing to optimize lead generation strategies and nurture prospective client relationships.
  • Maintain detailed records of outreach activities, lead interactions, and pipeline status in CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Support sales activities across multiple industries, including automotive, consumer goods, retail, and industrial sectors.

Why you belong at 4flow

  • You have a degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Relations, or a related field.
  • Previous SDR experience is required, preferably in B2B SaaS, consulting, or supply chain/logistics industries.
  • You have advanced English skills. Both written and spoken, to confidently interact with US-based executives.
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing lead pipelines and CRM systems.
  • You thrive on making connections and enjoy reaching out to Managers, Directors, and C-level contacts.
  • You have strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint for tracking KPIs and supporting sales initiatives.
  • You’re motivated by growth and eager to contribute to 4flow’s expansion in the US market from Brazil.

What We Offer

4flow offers a clearly defined vision, excellent job security, and outstanding opportunities for your individual development. As part of a highly international, fast-growing company with a vibrant corporate culture, you will enjoy a competitive base salary, an attractive bonus system, and a great benefits package.

title: Assistente Administrativo de Compras / Hospital Care
description:
Overview

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união, tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem-estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso à saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

Main responsibilities

  • Fazer a gestão dos contratos de suprimentos, através da plataforma Benner;
  • Acompanhar as solicitações de novos contratos imputadas pelos compradores;
  • Acompanhar o SLA de atendimento em interface com o jurídico do Hospital Care;
  • Realizar a interlocução entre fornecedor, jurídico, suprimentos e gestor do contrato para garantir a assinatura dos contratos dentro do prazo;
  • Fazer o acompanhamento e report de indicadores diversos.

Requirements and skills

  • Necessário Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Graduação concluída ou em andamento será um diferencial;
  • Desejável experiência na área de compras;
  • Domínio do pacote office (especialmente EXCEL);
  • Desejável ter conhecimento no sistema Benner;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido (3x presencial);
  • Residir em Campinas ou região.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

O Analista de Negociação e Cobrança será responsável por:

Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
Overview

A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Desenvolvemos líderes de excelência com ética e qualidade, contribuindo para gerar confiança no mercado de capitais e em economias ao redor do mundo. Contamos com quase 35.000 profissionais atendendo a indústria financeira globalmente, incluindo bancos, seguradoras e gestoras de patrimônio. No Brasil, atuamos junto aos principais centros mundiais para compartilhar conhecimento sobre tendências e regulamentações atuais, ajudando nossos clientes a resolver questões em gestão de riscos, controles internos, estratégia, operações e tecnologia da informação.

Este grupo de profissionais busca, neste momento, o candidato certo para integrar o time, desenvolver uma carreira sólida e ascendente, e contribuir para um mundo de negócios melhor para nossos colaboradores, clientes e comunidades.

Na EY, você terá liberdade, ferramentas e condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira única. Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), apoiamos as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos clientes do segmento financeiro, oferecendo soluções sob medida a partir de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas com perfis variados, como especialistas em Dados, UX, analistas de negócios e scrum masters.

Seu papel

Como Cientista de Dados Pleno, você atuará em clientes de grande porte, com possibilidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltadas para o segmento financeiro. Contará com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar preparado para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e comunidades.

Você poderá atuar diretamente com tecnologias avançadas de IA Generativa e LLMs (como GPT, LLaMA e Mistral). O ambiente é inovador, com forte incentivo à pesquisa aplicada e experimentação em IA. Haverá oportunidade de participar do desenvolvimento de soluções reais e escaláveis, com cultura colaborativa e times multidisciplinares, e potencial de crescimento acelerado em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você na nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e/ou correlatas;
  • Ampla experiência em Python, especialmente para aplicações de IA; domínio de frameworks de LLMs (ex.: Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain, OpenAI API);
  • Proficiência com pipelines de dados, ETL, Apache NiFi, Apache Kafka; prática com versionamento de código (Git), testes automatizados e programação orientada a objetos;
  • Vivência com integração entre sistemas via APIs ou mensagens. Prompt engineering e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura técnica e ferramentas.

Desejável – diferenciais:
- Experiência prática em projetos de IA/Data Science, preferencialmente em setor financeiro (bancos/seguradoras), tecnologia, consultorias ou startups;
- Atuação em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e participação em comunidades ou projetos open source de IA;
- Familiaridade com publicações, artigos ou apresentações em eventos de tecnologia;
- Experiência prévia com validação humana de modelos (human-in-the-loop);
- Certificações em Data Science (ex.: IBM Data Science, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer) ou cursos reconhecidos em ML/IA/Big Data.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar na evolução de modelos baseados em LLMs, desde o prompt engineering até a implantação em produção;
  • Criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando ferramentas de mercado (NiFi, Kafka);
  • Automatizar processos de ETL e integração entre sistemas;
  • Garantir qualidade, versionamento e testabilidade das soluções, atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

Condições

Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para remoto) nos escritórios da EY Brasil.

O que oferecemos

Vale alimentação, vale refeição, vale transporte, plano de saúde, assistência odontológica, universidade corporativa e outros benefícios, incluindo Educacionais, Gympass, PLR e muito mais. Conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, oferecemos experiências excepcionais com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento.

Acreditamos que a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Temos reconhecimento em programas de diversidade e equidade. Se você se sente desafiado(a), motivado(a) e valorizado(a) diariamente, venha fazer parte do nosso time e ajude-nos a construir um mundo de negócios melhor.

Carreiras na EY | LinkedIn | Instagram

A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados são considerados.

  • Negociar prazos e alinhamentos entre as partes, garantindo que as entregas estejam dentro do esperado e respeitando as diretrizes estratégicas;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

  • Experiência com ciência de dados;

O seu dia a dia

  • Executar análise avançada de dados (advanced analytics/ data science) utilizando conceitos de big data, para gerar insights para as áreas de negócio do grupo CPFL;
  • Avaliar, propor e implementar metodologias estatística, de inteligência artificial e machine learning, avaliando o contexto, prazo de entrega e dados disponíveis;
  • Liderar projetos de análise de dados com outras áreas para ganhos operacionais nas diversas unidades de negócio, construindo relacionamento com outras áreas, buscando oportunidades, subsídios para compreensão do escopo de trabalho e entendimento das regras envolvidas no negócio.
  • Trabalhar na aquisição e tratamento de dados de dados complexos, com foco em alta volumetria, criando códigos de extração replicáveis;
  • Realizar apresentações de nivelamento e resultados para todos os públicos da CPFL, incluindo reports aos executivos do grupo e redigir relatório de análise documentando os estudos realizados.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços .

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia eléctrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso praticamos ações afirmativas em que reservamos vagas para aumentar cada vez mais a representatividade de grupos sociais minorizados, como por exemplo, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência e pessoas negras. Valorizamos a diversidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Imerys delivers high-value-added, functional solutions to a great number of sectors, from processing industries to consumer goods. The Group draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge and expertise in material science to deliver solutions by beneficiating its mineral resources, synthetic minerals and formulations. Imerys’ solutions contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance, including heat resistance, hardness, conductivity, opacity, durability, purity, lightness, filtration, absorption and water repellency. Imerys is determined to develop responsibly, in particular by fostering the emergence of environmentally-friendly products and processes.

Imerys delivers sustainability as a core value and aims to grow skills and careers across its global footprint.

Role Summary

On March 28, 2024, Imerys Group published a press release announcing exclusive negotiations with Flacks Group for the contemplated divestment of its assets producing kaolin, ground calcium carbonate (GCC), precipitated calcium carbonate (PCC), and talc, which primarily serve the paper markets in North America, South America, Asia and Europe. The future company formed by these industrial sites is expected to start operating under a new brand in 2024 and will offer mineral solutions for industries worldwide. The new company will use its global footprint, assets and know-how to develop opportunities and foster innovation. Sustainability is a core value of this company.

The activity has an annual revenue of around €350 million (2023) and about 1,000 employees. The Company needs to reinforce existing teams to operate as a standalone organization and to meet ambitious development plans.

Role Overview

Drive organic and inorganic growth for customers and prospects in the perimeter you are responsible for. Support business and market developments, working with Business Development, S&T and Marketing. Be responsible for the profitability of the activity on all the customers present in your perimeter.

  • Ensure business performance by servicing the existing customer base and developing new growth opportunities
  • Develop plans and strategies for developing new commercial opportunities and achieving sales goals, with strong internal and external relationship building
  • Establish and nurture relationships with customers at multi-level management (upper management, purchasing, R&D)

  • Experience with test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Azure DevOps).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and how to integrate automated tests into the pipeline.
  • Analytical skills to identify failures, root causes, and propose solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with BDD/TDD methodologies.

Nice to have

  • Experience with performance testing (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
  • Experience with testing in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

More about you

  • You’re proactive and takes initiative to solve problems before they escalate.
  • You’re adaptable and comfortable working in dynamic environments with changing priorities.
  • You collaborate effectively within large teams, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues.
  • You’re analytical and detail-oriented, capable of critically evaluating processes and results.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, ensuring alignment with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Application Security Engineer to serve as a trusted partner to our software development teams. This role focuses on making our product secure by design—embedding security into how software is architected, written, deployed, and maintained. Unlike infrastructure security roles, this position centers on application-layer and code-level security, working closely with developers to enable fast, confident delivery by providing meaningful, actionable security tooling and feedback. This includes leveraging modern AI-assisted techniques to accelerate vulnerability analysis, exploit chaining, and demonstration of actual risk. You will ensure engineering teams move faster—not slower—while minimizing noise. This role is part of the IT & Security team and prioritizes embedding guardrails into developer workflows rather than enforcement gates.

About Nerdy: At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we\'re redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI platform fuses real-time human expertise with proprietary generative-AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale. We recruit the kind of technologists and operators you\'d bet on as solo founders - people who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10-times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win.

  • AI-Native at every level From the CEO to day-one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you\'re not wielding AI, you\'re not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
  • Free-market rigor Ideas rise or fall on merit and results - no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.
  • Full-stack ownership You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug.
  • Reward for contribution Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both what you achieve and how you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded.
  • Relentless exploration Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and - because only the paranoid survive - questioning every legacy assumption along the way.
  • Is Apolitical You stay focused on mission-aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Experience as an Application Security Engineer, Security Consultant, or Security-focused Software Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability patterns.
  • Ability to apply common web application attack techniques and create proof-of-concept exploits to validate whether vulnerabilities are exploitable in our environment.
  • Proven ability to analyze exploit chains and demonstrate actual risk, leveraging AI to accelerate discovery and validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Ruby, Go, JavaScript/React, and related frameworks.
  • Deep familiarity with OWASP guidance, including the OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and Secure Coding Guidelines.
  • Partner with DevOps to embed application security into CI/CD pipeline design and practices.
  • Ability to assess and communicate application risk in architectural and business context.
  • Comfortable demonstrating real-world exploits to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in an async-first, remote environment.

Preferred

  • Experience leveraging and adapting open-source tools and frameworks for application security testing and validation.
  • Experience with API security testing and continuous monitoring, leveraging AI for fuzzing, intelligent input generation, and automated discovery.
  • Experience building or maintaining secure development training programs.
  • Security certifications (OSWE, OSCP, GIAC) are a plus but not required.

Responsibilities

  • Enable engineering teams to move quickly while embedding security into development workflows—security and speed go hand-in-hand.
  • Partner with engineering on secure use of AI services, evaluating controls such as AI gateways, prompt inspection, and policy enforcement.
  • Identify, prioritize, and implement security tooling in developer environments and CI/CD pipelines, with AI-assisted triage to reduce noise and highlight exploitable risks.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify vulnerabilities in code, APIs, and dependencies; improve secure coding awareness; and participate in design reviews and threat modeling.
  • Demonstrate practical exploit techniques to raise security awareness and drive remediation, including chaining multiple weaknesses across services to illustrate end-to-end risk.
  • Analyze vulnerabilities across code, dependencies, APIs, and logic, with AI-assisted techniques to identify and prioritize exploit chains.
  • Build or adapt automation scripts and tools for continuous security validation, using AI copilots to accelerate script generation and validation.
  • Provide coaching, documentation, and embedded training to help developers understand and apply security guidance within their workflows.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and application security threats and detection techniques.
  • Lead incident response activities as part of the incident commander rotation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of incident response runbooks and playbooks.

Unlock Your Full Potential at Nerdy

Join our worldwide team—work from home, get great pay, and help shape the future of learning. Here\'s what you get:

  • Competitive USD Compensation: Enjoy a market-leading rate paid in U.S. dollars.
  • 100% Remote (Home Country Only): Work from anywhere in your home country—no relocation required, no borders crossed.
  • Flexible Time Off: Our flexible PTO lets you recharge on your own terms and when you need it the most.
  • Local Holiday Pay: We honor your nation\'s official holidays with paid time off—celebrate what matters to you.
  • Continuous Learning: Get a free, all-inclusive learning membership for you and your household—including 1-on-1 tutoring hours, unlimited on-demand classes, and access to our full suite of learning products and services.
  • Supercharge with AI: Gain exclusive access to cutting-edge AI tools that boost your productivity, making you feel almost super-human (cape not included).
  • Feedback-Rich, Collaborative Culture: Tap into regular training, peer reviews, and a team that treats every team member as a vital collaborator and owner in our success.
  • Make a Global Impact: Your expertise fuels an innovative platform used by learners around the world—be part of something transformative.

The Bottom Line: If you\'re driven by impact, energized by ownership, and excited to help shape what\'s next, you\'ll thrive here. We move fast, think big, and reward those who deliver. This isn\'t a traditional corporate environment - it\'s a place to do the most meaningful work of your career.

O que nós procuramos?

  • Experiência anterior em vendas ou Trade Marketing;
  • Gerenciamento de conflitos;

Quais seriam suas principais responsabilidades?

  • Responsável pelo atendimento dos clientes estratégicos de determinada região (quantitativa ou qualitativamente), sendo fundamental criar uma parceria sustentável considerando o impacto de seus resultados na unidade;
  • Atingir os objetivos de sell in e faseamento, definidos para cada cliente sob sua responsabilidade, analisando os indicadores de performance da sua área através dos relatórios gerenciais e definindo ações no sentido de atingir os objetivos estabelecidos;

  • Ser responsável por indicar oportunidades e necessidades de melhoria na sua área de atuação;
  • Contribuir no processo de desenvolvimento das equipes dos clientes, levando treinamentos e informações a balconistas, veterinários, gerentes e donos de lojas;
  • Acompanhar pedidos, pendências financeiras, logística, ações de trade, tabela de preços e estoque de seus clientes;
  • Expectativa de 1 a 4 visitas diárias;
  • Participar e aderir todos os requerimentos de segurança de alimentos, sistema de gestão de qualidade, e programas de segurança do site garantindo que todos os padrões sejam cumpridos;
  • Analisar dados de vendas regularmente, encontrando oportunidades e riscos e propor planos de ação para melhorar o desempenho do cliente e monitorar os resultados de acordo com as propostas de ROI;
  • Implantar e acompanhar a conformidade e governança do JBP/Menu Card;
  • Interface proativa com suprimentos e finanças durante toda a jornada do pedido de vendas;
  • Responsável por todos os investimentos nos clientes KAR alavancados através de TPE ou do JBP e Menu Card;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Apoiar e implantar planos e iniciativas de marketing e trade marketing dentro dos clientes KAR, em parceria com os departamentos de Marketing e Trade Marketing;
  • Ser um membro ativo no cultivo da colaboração e compartilhamento de melhores práticas dentro da comunidade local, regional e global da Royal Canin.

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa multinacional com presença marcante nos países onde atua, produzindo produtos de alta qualidade e marcas fortes em todo o mundo como M&Ms, Snickers, Twix, Skittles, Uncle Ben’s, Pedigree, Whiskas, Cesar, Royal Canin.
